Methodology

Snapshot prepared October 4, 2026. The unit is a unique catalog ID. A specification-coverage count means at least three fields are recorded; it does not certify those fields. A strict image match requires an exact classification and a normalized pictured-model identity matching the product name. Other pictures remain available but are not counted as exact.

What not to infer

This is not a representative market sample. Counts reflect what has been indexed, including historical products and catalog variants. They do not measure popularity, sales, stock or performance. A missing field is a maintenance task, not proof that the product lacks that feature.

Reuse and reproduce

The site-authored aggregate counts are offered under CC0-1.0. Product photography and 3D files retain their own source licenses. Rebuild the report from the repository with the publication generator; the content hash identifies this snapshot. Preserve its date and limitations when citing it.
